column1: # Final Fight 30th Anniversary CPS2 Edition (ffightae_cps2 / hbmame ffightaec2)
# ARRANGE trigger map -> Final Fight CD (USA) CD-DA.  A RE-KEY of the settled
# CPS1 map (ffight_arrange_trigger_map.tsv): the CD side (track roles, loop
# authoring) is unchanged and already user ear-confirmed; only the arcade-side
# keying moves to this hack's CPS2 QSound commands.
# THESE ROWS BUILD ffightae_cps2_arrange.cpk (pack/build_ffightae_cps2_arrange.py) --
# DELIBERATELY ITS OWN PACK.  A shared CPS1+CPS2 ffight_arrange.cpk was
# built, emulation-gated and committed (6be153cb), then reverted on review:
# it re-opened the shipped CPS1 pack's hardware validation, exercised the
# never-hardware-tested loader clamp on CPS1 cores, and exposed the CPS1
# byte rows to this hack's own page-0 SFX bank (see the builder docstring).
# Play rows carry the measured trigger gain 0x2d (EBU R128 vs the hack's own
# QSound music, median +8.9 LU over 18 pairs); loop authoring is imported
# from build_ffight_arrange so the two packs cannot drift.
# THE SET.  grego2d/rotwang's CPS2 conversion of Final Fight: 68K program
# ported onto CPS2, sound rebuilt on the SFA3 (sz3) QSound driver 1.71 with a
# modified sz3.01 (Z80 bank 0) + modified sz3.11m (sample ROM), stock sz3.02 +
# sz3.12m.  MiSTer set ffightae_cps2.zip (Arcade_Offset MRA, jtcps2);
# MAME oracle: hbmame `ffightaec2` (same CRCs, renamed parts + stock sz3.12m).
# Phase-0 descriptor: manifests/protocol/ffightaec2.json (driver banner
# "1.71 /CPS2 1998 /May.", record layout = sfa3ud: cmd 01/03, args 05/07/09,
# handshake 1f, record-then-handshake).
# THE KEYING LAW (measured, 2026-09-01).  The hack pages its sounds by high
# byte: 0x01xx = the CPS1 ffight cue space carried over LOW-BYTE-IDENTICAL
# (music AND the dense SFX/voice space around it), 0x02xx/0x03xx = new/remapped
# SFX pages.  Music rows below therefore key 0x0100 | <cps1 cmd>.  Evidence:
#   * 0x0140 fires at coin-up stage 1 entry (slum street on screen, f2112) and
#     at the attract slum demo -- CPS1 0x40 R1 Slum.
#   * 0x0142 fires at the attract subway demo (train-interior snapshot f14250,
#     3P demo) -- CPS1 0x42 R2 Subway.
#   * 0x0155 fires on the SELECT PLAYER screen (snapshot f1150) -- CPS1 0x55.
#   * 0x0150 fires between select and stage entry (f1757, 5.9 s before the
#     stage theme -- the CPS1 area-map window exactly) -- CPS1 0x50.
#   * 0x0152 fires at the attract story's song position; ring->song->answer
#     order and spacing match CPS1 US to 0.1 s (see OPENING below).
#   * full-page injection sweep (recorded injection sweep): the
#     page is dense like CPS1's byte space; every mapped row renders long
#     sustained music (recorded long renders).
# Rows not behaviorally anchored ride this law pending the listening-kit
# review (listening kit): 0x0141, 0x0143-0x0149, 0x014c, 0x0151,
# 0x0153, 0x0154, 0x0157, 0x0158.  Flagged hardest for the ear: 0x0157 (its
# injected render is sparse/ambient-like where CPS1 0x57 is a jingle).
# === OPENING SEQUENCE (differs from the CPS1 US pack -- JP-STYLE ENTRY) ===
# Attract cycle 1 (latch trace, cold boot):  ring 0x03be 16.8 s -> SONG 0x0152
# 23.0 s -> answer click 0x03c5 24.7 s -> Belger laugh 0x03e2 x3 46.1-47.5 s ->
# Damnd laugh 0x0368 58.7 s -> TITLE 73.1-73.5 s (20-frame snapshot cadence),
# gone by ~78.8 s.  This is the CPS1 US timeline shifted ~10.15 s earlier
# (CPS2 boots faster); ring->title window 62.0 s vs CPS1's 61.9 s.
# BUT attract cycle 2+ omit the phone prologue and enter DIRECTLY on 0x0152
# (147.2 s, no ring/click) -- the ring fires ONCE PER BOOT.  A CPS1-US-style
# entry on the ring would leave every later attract cycle with a silent story
# block, so this pack enters on the SONG cue like the CPS1 JP pack does:
#   0x0152 -> PLAY tr25, suppress=1   (the board's song, gated, entry point)
#   0x03be ring / 0x03c5 click       -> no rows: native SEs pass through
# Loop sizing: the JP authored wrap transfers VERBATIM -- one 2.879 s bar-wrap
# (ls=1056928 le=1183904 count=1, US-disc sample coordinates, no loop_shift)
# ends the master at 23.0+47.5+2.9 = 73.4 s, inside the measured title
# appearance window 73.1-73.5 s.  Same landing the JP CPS1 pack authored
# (music end 0.1-0.3 s after the title appears, ~5 s before it gives way).
# === CONTROLS (measured on this driver, ctrl_probe 2026-09-01) ===
# 0xff00 stops the BGM and the driver still starts songs after it (STOP row in
# protocols.py); 0xff05 does NOT stop music (fires at coin-in -- the alpha2
# SFX-slot release; mapping it would cut the title music at coin-in, the
# sfz2al lesson); 0xff07 argb=0x00 fades the BGM out, 0xff06 argb=0xff leaves
# it at unity -- the CONTROL_ALPHA2_ARCADE fade-from-arg-byte semantics
# (VERB_FADE_KEEP both).  Neither ff06 nor ff07 has been observed emitted by
# this 68K yet (attract + coin + gameplay traces show ff00/ff05 only).
# cols: cmd  verb  suppress  cd_track  cue
